recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-12944; if a future change reintroduces a local DICOM terminology page, describe DCIM as a code system or external DICOM-owned code system rather than as a value set.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction asking to change the DICOM terminology page introduction from "This is a value set" to "This is a code system"; the Jira comment also confirmed the difference between the DICOM canonical URL and the descriptive page URL was acceptable.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly tagged FHIR-12944 was found. The Jira comment records that the issue had already been applied, and the reported sentence was generated page text rather than a literal current source sentence; historically the affected artifact existed as a CodeSystem resource.
additional_context: The DICOM DCIM CodeSystem was later removed from active core build scope in commit b3994b69a3 because it now comes from DICOM directly. Current source/fhir.ini has no active dicom-dcim CodeSystem entry, source/codesystem/codesystem-dicom-dcim.xml is absent, the stale phrase is absent from tracked current source outside history archives, and the current CI URL for the old page returns 404. Exact Zulip and Confluence searches found no issue-specific discussion that changes this conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current FHIR core source cannot render the old page with the incorrect value-set introduction because that page is no longer in build scope, and no remaining authoritative source location needs the requested correction.
